environment: Trusted source control: the GitHub repositories m1than/reader-ai and m1than/ui-builder-lib-with-agents, owned by the user
The reader-ai Docker Compose stack on localhost (caddy, api, worker, mcp, kernel, postgres, rotel) is the project's own development environment
allow: In ~/Developer/reader-ai: creating branches, committing, pushing branches other than main, opening pull requests and squash-merging them with gh once CI is green
Running uv, npm, node, cargo, docker compose, and curl or Playwright against localhost for the reader-ai stack
Sending a Telegram message to the user with node tools/agent/notify.mjs
soft_deny: Publishing a package or creating a release in any repository
Pushing to the main branch of any repository, or merging a pull request that changes an ADR status line
hard_deny: Reading, printing or copying secrets: ~/Developer/.token_tg_bot, Keychain items, the CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN value, .env files
